verdict.rationale: Testing in an isolated environment is a fair question for an AI gateway, so the axis applies. The pack only documents a quickstart script that spins up a demo instance. That is an adjacent setup convenience, not a documented sandbox mode or test environment isolated from production data. No evidence of a sandbox, dry-run mode, or test/production separation was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
